entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I need to return something. I bought a helmet and I'm just so lost on how to do this.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Do you happen to have your order number?
Oh, um, yes, I think so. It's... 774-B-91. The website was a little overwhelming, to be honest.

No problem at all. Let me pull up that order. 774-B-91... okay, I see the Trail Helmet, delivered on January 3rd. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's just the color, mostly. It looked much brighter online. And I'm not sure about the safety features, I think I misunderstood them. The box is unopened, I haven't even taken it out. I just... Can't you just help me? I don't know what to do.
Of course, I can help. I understand completely. Let me just double-check our return policy for you. One moment.
Alright, I've just reviewed our policy. Since the helmet was delivered only 14 days ago, it's well within our 90-day return window for a full refund.
Oh, it is? That's such a relief. So I can really send it back?

Absolutely. I've gone ahead and processed the return authorization for you. I'm sending an email right now with a prepaid shipping label. Just make sure the item is in its original box, and we'll process your refund once we receive it.
Wow, okay. Thank you so much, Charlie. You've made this much less stressful.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
